result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel row has vertically misaligned cards: image heights and badge/text baselines differ between items (Green Bowl Poké sits higher than Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccola), giving the row a broken, uneven appearance. Other observations are minor cosmetic notes.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the cards are vertically misaligned: the Green Bowl Poké card's image is taller/positioned higher while Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccola images start lower, so image tops, delivery-time badges, and restaurant titles sit at different vertical offsets across the row instead of aligning on a common baseline.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a fixed, equal image height and align items to a common top edge (e.g., flex align-items: flex-start with uniform card structure), so badges, titles, and delivery fees line up across the row.

issues.description: Because of the misalignment, the delivery-time badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') appear at inconsistent vertical positions relative to their images (overlapping the bottom edge on some cards but sitting inside the image area on others).
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time badge consistently (e.g., always overlapping the bottom-left corner of the card image) once card heights are unified.

issues.description: The category chip row after 'Healthy' shows a sliver of another chip at the right edge with no visual affordance (fade or scroll hint), which can look like a rendering artifact rather than intentional scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge gradient fade or peek padding so the horizontal scroll affordance reads as intentional.
